company.name: Digival IT Solutions
company.shortDescription: Digival IT Solutions develops digital learning, assessment, and education management software for higher education institutions.
company.description: Digival IT Solutions is an education technology company that develops digital transformation software and AI-enabled solutions for higher education institutions. Its products support academic management, assessment automation, curriculum planning, quality assurance, accreditation processes, and learning outcome tracking. The company provides customized platforms designed to align with institutional policies, competency-based education frameworks, and regulatory standards for colleges and universities.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,361,285, or 54.94% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,454,412 to $13,612,850, a 3.94x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
